and** [**iTunes**](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/gzcnh5hl6k56dq/aHR0cHM6Ly9pdHVuZXMuYXBwbGUuY29tL21vdmllL3NvbW0vaWQxMDQ3MjMwMjM3P2lnbi1tcHQ9dW8lM0Q1)**).** I first heard about this doc in blog comments after I interviewed [the brilliant and well-tattooed Richard Betts](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/3esphkh24nl4ok/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzEwLzA1L3JpY2hhcmQtYmV0dHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==). Richard passed the infamous Court of Master Sommeliers’ Masters Exam on his first attempt, becoming the ninth person in history ever to do so. It’s a Mount Everest BITCH of a test, and [only 256 people](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/4navhehp6ne653/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWFzdGVyc29tbWVsaWVycy5vcmcvYWJvdXQ=) have passed—in total and globally—over the last _40 years_(!). I put off watching this film because I feared it would be too highfalutin for this Long Island boy. Now, having seen it, I’m sorry I didn’t watch _SOMM_ ages ago. It’s a wonderful, brutal, endearing, and hilarious (especially the ball-busting scenes during study sessions) story of a few young men trying to find their place in the world by tackling something incredibly difficult. The editing is spot on, and you’re really cheering for these guys by the end. I loved it.

Here’s the official description: “Four men will do anything to pass the most difficult test you've never heard of. The Court of Master Sommeliers is one of the world's most exclusive organizations with an exam that covers every nuance of the world of wine, spirits and cigars. How much do you think you know about wine? SOMM will make you think again.”

bullets.title: Stephen Wolfram
bullets.note: Stephen is a computer scientist, physicist, and businessman. He is best known for his work in computer science, mathematics, and theoretical physics. In 2012, he was named an inaugural fellow of the American Mathematical Society. As an entrepreneur, he is the founder and CEO of the software company [Wolfram Research](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/8dhqhoh2qxvq2e/aHR0cDovL3d3dy53b2xmcmFtLmNvbS8=), where he has worked as chief designer of Mathematica and the Wolfram|Alpha answer engine.

bullets.title: Distributed, with Matt Mullenweg
bullets.note: Finally, my friend [Matt Mullenweg](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/doieh0ho8mg8oo/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzAyLzA5L21hdHQtbXVsbGVud2VnLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=) ([@photomatt](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/72f7h8h6wm7w68/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9waG90b21hdHQ=)) has a podcast. He is the founder of a ~900-person company ([Automattic](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh4qd28cd/zptghnhkp8vpkr/aHR0cHM6Ly9hdXRvbWF0dGljLmNvbS8=)) that has no offices; employees are distributed across 68 countries. He is one of the friends I call most for advice on a wide range of subjects, including product development, open-source projects, investing, and music.
